verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street is an immigration legal service whose employer offering includes multi-case dashboards, so a bulk-operations question is a fair one to ask. However, the only related evidence is a claim that cases run in parallel with status dashboards. That describes the firm's own handling capacity, not a user-facing way to act on many items at once. The probes also find no API, OpenAPI spec, or llms.txt through which an AI-native user could script bulk actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Run multiple cases in parallel with clean workflows, SLAs, and status dashboards.
